# Belt drive turntable with built-in phono preamp

Price: $230
Condition: Good, plays well.

A belt drive deck with a new stylus fitted in December 2025. The built-in phono preamp means it plugs straight into powered speakers.

## Known faults

The left dust cover hinge is cracked. The lid lifts off rather than staying up.

Pickup from Enmore. You can hear it play first.

Audiophile turntable in my favorite color! $320.
